text:
neha_csm: Quick heads-up — Crestwell is onboarding a new parent company as the payor and wants that to take effect at renewal. They also asked about a one-time pro-rated credit for terminating the hosted add-on early. Can we map the execution path?

tom_sales: Thanks — I spoke to Alex earlier. Sales is ok with the payor swap if procurement sends a PO for the new entity and legal signs an amendment. Need finance confirmation on net terms and whether we can apply the credit.

rachel_legal: I can do the amendment, but I need the exact new billing entity name, tax ID, and the effective date. Also want to confirm signatory authority for the new party.

maria_cs: From onboarding side — we need to know whether they want to switch to Dedicated at renewal or keep Hosted. That affects provisioning lead time. Alex, which route do you want?

alex_crestwell: Hi all — new parent = "AcmeGroup, Inc." Tax ID 12-3456789. They plan to take over billing 2026-05-01. Prefer to keep Dedicated (they want isolation). PO will come from Acme procurement. Also they asked about early termination credit for the unused hosted add-on (about 3 months left).

finance_bot: Please provide: 1) PO pdf or PO number, 2) Acme AR contact, 3) requested invoicing cadence. Note: Net30 is default for enterprise — confirm if they require Net60.

tom_sales: Confirming pricing: Dedicated baseline + migration fee. If we accept early termination credit, propose a pro-rated credit calculation: (Hosted add-on monthly * remaining months) * 0.9 (apply 10% restocking/service cost). I'll attach numbers once legal OKs amendment.

neha_csm: To keep execution smooth: legal drafts amendment referencing original SOW, finance issues invoice change, customer signs via DocuSign, then ops schedules Dedicated provisioning window. I'm tagging @rachel_legal and @finance_bot for drafts/confirmations.

rachel_legal: Draft amendment below — please review. If agreed I'll send via DocuSign.

rachel_legal: ```
Amendment to Master Services Agreement:
- Change billing entity to: AcmeGroup, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789)
- Effective date: 2026-05-01
- Early termination credit: Pro-rata credit for remaining Hosted add-on term. Calculation to be appended based on finance calculation (example line item included).
- Signatory: Authorized Purchasing Representative, AcmeGroup, Inc.
```

docusign-bot: Document prepared by @rachel_legal and queued for signature. Sending to alex_crestwell (AcmeGroup) — DocuSign link: https://docusign.example/abc123 (expires in 7 days).

alex_crestwell: Got it, procurement will route PO + sign the DocuSign today. Can you estimate Dedicated provisioning lead time? Want to coordinate migration to avoid overlap.

maria_cs: Typical Dedicated setup + migration window is 10 business days after signed amendment + initial capacity allocation. We can add a day for KV cache warmup. Recommend target start 2026-05-04 to minimize downtime.

finance_bot: Pro-rated credit calc (draft): Hosted add-on monthly $4,500, remaining full months 3 -> raw $13,500. Apply 10% service factor -> credit $12,150. Please confirm acceptance. PO should reference Invoice-To: AcmeGroup, Inc., PO#: <insert>. Net30 ok.

tom_sales: Sales approves the credit calc. Rachel — if wording matches finance, go ahead and send final DocuSign.

rachel_legal: Updating amendment to include the $12,150 credit line and PO reference clause, then sending.

docusign-bot: Sent. Status: Delivered to alex_crestwell.

alex_crestwell: Signed this morning :thumbsup:. PO# AG-2026-089 coming by email from procurement in 2h.

docusign-bot: Completed. Signed by AcmeGroup. Download available at https://docusign.example/download/xyz789

finance_bot: Received PO AG-2026-089 via email and matched to amendment. Net30, billing entity changed. Will schedule first invoice to Acme for 2026-05-01. Credit of $12,150 will appear as line item on first invoice.

maria_cs: Ops — please provision Dedicated environment for Crestwell/Acme, target start 2026-05-04. I'll schedule the migration kickoff and send the checklist to Alex.

neha_csm: Great — capture for renewal ops: Payor swap done, amendment signed, PO received, credit applied, Dedicated provisioning scheduled. Lessons learned: require PO + sign-off checklist to be completed 7 days before provisioning.

alex_crestwell: Thanks team. Procurement sent PO and signed doc. Looking forward to the migration kickoff.

tom_sales: I'll update the renewal tracker and mark this as executed. Closing loop with Billing & Ops.

neha_csm: Quick ask for post-migration feedback — Alex, can we schedule a 30-day check-in after cutover to capture performance & any billing questions?

alex_crestwell: Yes — schedule it. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
